collection.title: Dodge Journey 2009 to 2020 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Dodge Journey 2009 - 2020 requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 18" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm, there is also the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this Journey 2007 Onwards which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
